ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Ashoka Buildcon Limited has secured a significant Letter of Acceptance from the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) for an Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) project valued at Rs. 865.90 Crore (excluding GST). This contract involves constructing an 8-lane access-controlled expressway section in Gujarat, slated for completion within 18 months, materially enhancing the company's order book and future revenue visibility. While the project includes a 10-year defect liability period, no immediate red flags or related party concerns are identified, signifying a positive strategic win.
